fields.kicker: Before you buy a wallet 'for life'
fields.hook: Third wallet in six years? Ridge's wallet warranty prints the fee: $17.95 to replace a lost one today, up to twice.
fields.reason_1: Lost, stolen or accidentally damaged? A replacement for $17.95 today, up to two times.
